How a Homeless Teen Created Louis Vuitton

Louis Vuitton was homeless at 13 and walked 225 miles to Paris. Here’s how he turned a flaw in old-school luggage into the most valuable luxury brand on Earth. 🧳

He redesigned round-top trunks into flat ones — and that one fix became a global empire.
